description: San Bernardino County Assessor-Recorder-County Clerk secured roll files for the FactLot Registry. See docs/registry/sources/ca-san-bernardino-assessor.md.

sources.license: Public record; no license stated for the files. The county website policy says its information is intended to give the public immediate access to public information; the roll page adds a limitation-of-liability notice
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record. The roll page says the data is maintained for internal use only in the determination of property value for taxation (a statement of purpose within the liability disclaimer).
sources.notes: Free, direct links on the property-information page; no login, form, fee or click-through. Layout read from the publisher's PDFs (downloaded by hand, small). Owner names and all address fields are withheld by the publisher under Gov. Code 7928.205: the monthly layout lists NAME, SITUS and MAIL fields as HIDDEN (the annual NPP891 layout still lists them; whether the file leaves them blank is unconfirmed). Use code list: Appendix B of the Property Characteristics layout (Characteristic_Layout_Info_WithGovtCode.pdf); the roll layout says 'list available on request'. NOT YET DOWNLOADED: the collector run stalled (server streams about 3 MB then stops; shared connection saturated), so file URLs are confirmed by HEAD (200, sizes 20-49 MB) but not by a completed download, hence verified stays false. Run: python -m factlot.collector snapshot --config registry/sources/ca/ca-san-bernardino-assessor.json --out collected --include-unverified, then flip verified once the files are in. robots.txt on arc.sbcounty.gov has no rules for generic agents.
